headline: Issued compliance certificate, three Determinations of Applicability, and continued several hearings to June 30, 2026
summary: The Commission handled certificates of compliance, reviewed new and continued Notices of Intent for projects at 58 West Street, 15 Wirling Drive, and 8 Upland Road, and issued Negative 3 Determinations of Applicability for projects at 228 Common Lane, 16 Robinson Road, and 564 Hale Street. It also discussed a proposed sidewalk project near a vernal pool at 90 & 92 Boyles Street with the Mayor and City Engineer, approved a restoration plan for 181 Elliott Street, and approved mileage expenditures and prior meeting minutes.
decisions: Issued a Partial Certificate of Compliance for 47 Corning Street, DEP File #5-345, including perpetual condition #5; motion carried 3-0.
Continued the hearing for 58 West Street (No DEP File as of posting) to June 30, 2026; motion carried 3-0.
Continued the Certificate of Compliance review for 12 Fosters Point, DEP File #5-283, to June 30, 2026; motion carried 3-0.
Continued the hearing for 15 Wirling Drive (No DEP File as of filing) to June 30, 2026; motion carried 3-0.
Continued the hearing for 8 Upland Road (No DEP File as of filing) to June 30, 2026; motion carried 3-0.
Issued a Negative 3 Determination of Applicability with conditions for 228 Common Lane; motion carried 3-0.
Issued a Negative 3 Determination of Applicability with conditions for 16 Robinson Road; motion carried 3-0.
Issued a Negative 3 Determination of Applicability with conditions for 564 Hale Street; motion carried 3-0.
Approved the restoration plan for 181 Elliott Street as presented; motion carried 3-0.
Amended the Enforcement Order for 181 Elliott Street to require restoration, plantings, and repairs completed by June 30, 2026; motion carried 3-0.
Approved Conservation Agent May mileage of $29.35 and Conservation Field Inspector May mileage of $14.20; motion carried 3-0.
Approved the meeting minutes of May 19, 2026, as amended; motion carried 3-0.

 Boyles Street 208 
 209

Mayor Michael Cahill explains that the City has been working to establish sidewalks for the 212 
safety of children and families along the whole length of Lakeshore Avenue and turning left onto 213 
Cross Lane. This has also been completed along a stretch of Boyles Street from Hale Street but 214 
the end of Boyle Street where it connects with Cross Lane and the train tracks has not been 215 
completed. The City is trying to establish a sidewalk on the left-hand side of this area. There is a 216 
vernal pool to the left of the road facing the train tracks. The 100’ No Disturb Zone to a Vernal 217 
Pool extends to both sides of the roadway. The intention is to get the sidewalk as close to the 218 
train tracks as possible, working with the MBTA to get a crossing of the track itself. The request 219 
is to work with the Commission to extend the sidewalk at the left edge of the roadway, given that 220 
the vernal pool is to the left of this area. The City has considered crossing the street with it before 221 
getting to the vernal pool, but it would be preferable to stay on one side of the road and not have 222 
to add two crosswalks, especially in areas where roadway visibility is not as good.  223
